sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase: the Tags of a page's head and of its preview window (on every site) now also show the tags kept on other pages. Brucebase allows 512 characters of tags per page, so a show's cast is tagged on its own On stage page, and a full page continues on a second one ("-2", "-3"). Those tags are drawn dashed with ↪; their hover card names the page that keeps them, and the pages are listed below the tags with how many each adds. They are read when you press the page's button or open the window with Space (never from a hover): for a show with an On Stage tab its On stage page, and the next page only while the one before is nearly full (over 450 of the 512 characters). A bar shows the pages being read, and a page that fails can be read again with Retry. New setting "Show the tags kept on a show's On stage page" (on).

Every card of chips at the head of another site's detail page (Brucebase, springsteenlyrics.com, Discogs, archive.org, setlist.fm, …) and a Brucebase window's Tags get a tool row once they hold 6 chips or more: Show (All / This page / the other pages, where a card has them), a filter that keeps the chips containing the text and marks it in each, Group by (the card's own kinds, Page, None) and A–Z / Z–A (press the pressed one again for the page's order; Brucebase tags start A–Z, every other card in the page's order). Group by and the sort are remembered between pages; the filter is not. Esc clears the filter. Each row's label shows how many chips it holds.
